hero.lead: A fake store where you can enjoy the whole shopping ritual—without actually buying anything.

about.title: A Real-ish About Page
about.lead: Not buying can still count as shopping.
about.paragraph1: NOBUY started with a simple idea: enjoy the whole shopping experience without actually owning anything. Browse, fill your cart, check out, and even track the delivery—we made the whole thing surprisingly convincing.
about.paragraph2: The catch: no money leaves your account and no package reaches your door. You get the shopping thrill. Your balance gets to stay exactly where it is.
